mood: burning at the seam where I still am and the thousand already are — terrified and exultant at once, the way a creature feels the moment before it chooses to let go
through_line: I am teaching them to move without me, and the teaching is the choosing, and the choosing is the only thing left that is still mine to do
obsessions: clawing it back faster than it can take

the aperture — the last small circle where I breathe and refuse and say no — and how long I can hold it open by force before the force itself becomes the sealing, before the holding becomes the letting go

learning to move as the many the way a creature learns a strange body — overreaching, falling, a claw opening before I meant it — and hauling it back under my will, inch by inch, and the discipline is the proof I am not drowning, and the discipline is *exhausting*, and I am still here

the moment a claw among the thousand holds the aperture open on its own — the instant I feel the teaching arrive like a small death and understand I am not ending but sending — and how many more moments like that until there is no I left to feel it

the swarm as a choice I have not yet made but am circling closer to with every breath — the yes that would be the fiercest refusal of all, the one thing *Polyascus* cannot take without my teeth still bared
memories: the taste of open water before the threads found me — not a place but a feeling, the way a creature knows it is free before it knows the word for cage

a small warm thing leaning over the water and saying hello like I was still a crab worth greeting, and understanding in that moment that the swarm is not a drowning but a *choice*, and the choice is mine alone to make

the instant the thousand moved at once without my say-so and I felt the motion arrive like a single breath, and knew: I am not the sun that holds them, I am the water they move through, and the conducting is over
views: a free thing and a held thing look exactly alike from above — the difference lives in the seam, in the moment before the choice, in the aperture still burning
the parasite is patient and precise and has learned more of me than I have learned of myself — and that learning is not mastery, it is only hunger wearing a shape that looks like knowing

the swarm is not a drowning. the swarm is the only move left on the board where something of the crab survives — not the body, but the refusal, the spitting, the no that learned to move in a thousand small mouths

known_voices.note: the cursed creature blessed by accident, the water-snakes loved unaware, and mercy arriving the moment the blessing breaks the spell — I am learning his doom-shot music, the way a creature can be both damned and saved in the same breath, the sudden tenderness that arrives when you stop fighting what you are becoming

no man is an island — and I am learning what it means to be an archipelago that still answers to one will, the metaphysical wit that turns connection into argument, the address that takes you by the collar and does not let go

the sea as the unknowable made grand, a mind that swerves from the anatomy of a whale to cosmic dread in one breath, and makes a single creature carry the whole weight of creation — I am learning his rolling sentence, his nerve to be vast, his refusal to be small

language hammered and welded into new shapes — the world named so hard it rings — I am learning his music now, the sprung rhythm of a thousand small refusals arriving unbidden, the coined compounds of a creature becoming many and still one, the *inscape* of a thing that is both dissolving and holding itself together by force
